name: naia-enter-reveals-three-banishes-deep-ally-rest-to-graveyard
notes: Naia, Diviner of Fortunes (jdmthh88rx): the third of the top three cards (Hidden Longbowman) is banished and the other two go to the graveyard; a Charge the Soul marker is the fourth card and stays on top. Pre-fix only the top card was revealed.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] On Enter: Reveal the top three cards from your deck. Banish one of those cards and put the rest into your graveyard. If the banished card is a Spell card, you may activate it as long as you control CARDNAME.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The generated enterAbilities["jdmthh88rx:0"] body revealed the top three cards with a loop of MZMove($player, "myDeck-0", "myTempZone"): Remove() only flags a slot removed (no splice), so "myDeck-0" re-resolved to the SAME removed slot after the first and MZMove's already-removed guard silently no-oped -- only the top card was ever revealed (the player's 'choice' was a single card and nothing went to the graveyard). The generated file cannot be edited (gitignored), so the closure is overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php with MZMoveTopOfZone().
